scenes.text: NASA rovers like Curiosity and Opportunity have photographed them.
It's the opposite of Earth, where sunsets glow orange and red.
Fine dust in the Martian air scatters blue light forward, close to the Sun.
So as the Sun sets, a cool blue glow surrounds it.
Meanwhile, the daytime sky on Mars looks a dusty butterscotch color.
Would you rather watch a sunset on Earth or on Mars?

title: Sunsets on Mars are blue 🌅
caption: NASA rovers have photographed blue sunsets on Mars. Fine dust scatters blue light forward around the setting Sun, the opposite of Earth's red sunsets. 🌅
